emerging_watch: Watching whether the Banks-vs-Pharma leadership handoff CONFIRMS: the margin is only 0.01 and both are crowded. I am watching for either theme to open a durable score gap of >0.10 over 10 sessions with no deterioration in breadth — if one does, the two-theme structure resolves; if they stay tied, leadership remains unresolved and both retain size-down caution only.
